summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Bulk Product Upload feature. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed for Admin Dashboard, Product Manager, and Vendor Dashboard. The bulk upload system correctly handles CSV/Excel parsing, validation, preview, and publish workflows.
seed_data_creation: Test products created during publish tests with unique SKUs (PUBLISH_TEST_*, DOUBLE_PUB_*, VALID_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk upload feature fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/products/bulk/sample-csv (download template), POST /api/products/bulk/preview (parse CSV/Excel + optional ZIP), POST /api/products/bulk/publish/{session_id} (create products). Variants format: Color:Size:Qty;... (e.g., Black:36:20;Red:M:30). Admin login endpoint is /api/admin/auth/login (not /api/admin/login). openpyxl installed for Excel support.
